# function: ptr_name

```terraform
provider::powerdns::ptr_name("192.0.2.1")
# "1.2.0.192.in-addr.arpa."
provider::powerdns::ptr_name("2001:db8::1")
# "1.0.0.….8.b.d.0.1.0.0.2.ip6.arpa."
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The name a PTR record sits at, for either address family.
resource "powerdns_record" "ptr" {
  zone   = provider::powerdns::reverse_zone_name("192.0.2.0/24")
  name   = provider::powerdns::ptr_name("192.0.2.1")
  type   = "PTR"
  ttl    = 3600
  values = ["www.example.com."]
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
ptr_name(address string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `address` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address.
